summary: Approved as unmatched behavioral source with zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: The implementation follows the original loop, including ordered grouped copies, untouched trailing bytes, null-destination handling and destination advancement. The test calls the original and compares complete buffers and return values across empty, unaligned, overlapping and self-copy cases. An independent disassembly and source-hash check agreed with the submitted evidence. The portable interface differs from the original register calling convention, as disclosed. Native Windows compilation covers the submitted implementation; sampled tests do not establish all-input equivalence.
